defense, national security, and intelligence missions ◦ Selected to deliver a fully managed AI cloud environment supporting biological research for DARPA alongside Parallel Works ◦ Entered into a multi-year agreement with Solidigm securing priority access to enterprise SSD capacity Business Outlook We are raising our full year 2026 revenue guidance to a range of $13.0 billion to $13.3 billion. We are also raising our full year 2026 adjusted operating income 2 guidance to a range of $1.275 billion to $1.375 billion, representing a 26% increase at the midpoint compared with our prior guidance. We continue to expect more than 1.85 gigawatts of active power at year-end. We now expect full year 2026 capital expenditures of $37 billion to $39 billion, raising the low end of our prior guidance range of $35 billion to $39 billion. This is as a result of our expectation to deploy infrastructure and deliver it to customers sooner than planned. We expect interest expense for Q4 2026 in the range of $1.05 to $1.15 billion. Finally, we are raising our annualized run-rate revenue 3 guidance to $20 billion to $21 billion to exit 2026. et strategy. We currently sell access to our platform either through committed contracts, which are take-or-pay, or on-demand, which are pay-as-you-go. Committed contracts generally have a predetermined term and start either on a fixed date or when we deliver the capacity specified in the contract. For each of the three months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, committed contracts accounted for 98% of our revenue. There is no guarantee that in the future customers will continue to be willing to enter into, and that the industry will continue to support, a take-or-pay model, and any move towards a pay-as-you-go and other consumption-based models will impact our ability to forecast our expected cash flows and
